africa-day: (Ekubhiyozeleni uSuku lweAfrika lwama-25, esi Sicelo soQeqesho sePi Pioneers siyaqaliswa)
memorial-text:
Eli Ziko LeMfundo linikezelwe kudade wethu omdala esithandayo Christina Muzheki Manjengwa owaphumla ngo-8 Agasti 2026 waza wangcwatywa ngo-11 Agasti eyiholide yamaQhawe aseZimbabwe.
Uthando lwakho, isikhokelo namandla akho ayaqhubeka ekhuthaza injongo yethu yokuxhobisa iAfrika.
Ngunaphakade ezintliziyweni zethu. Phumla ngamandla, Dade.
intro-p1: I-Pi Network yimali yedijithali kunye neprojekthi ye-ecosystem yehlabathi eyenzelwe ukwenza i-cryptocurrency ifikeleleke kwaye ibe luncedo kumntu wonke.
intro-p2: Ngokungafaniyo nezinye ii-cryptocurrencies ezifuna oomatshini bokumba abiza kakhulu, i-Pi Network ivumela abantu abaqhelekileyo ukuba bathathe inxaxheba ngokuthe ngqo kwiifowuni zabo.
intro-list:
• Yakha uqoqosho lwedijithali olubandakanya wonke umntu ngaphandle kweebhanki
  • Xhobisa abantu abaqhelekileyo kwihlabathi liphela ngokugrumba kwefowuni
  • Yandisa ukusetyenziswa kokwenyani ngokusebenzisa izinto eziluncedo kunye neeDApps
  • Xhasa urhwebo lomntu nomntu kunye nokunciphisa iindleko
  • Yenziwe ngooGqirha baseStanford - uGqirha Nicolas Kokkalis kunye noGqirha Chengdiao Fan
  • Ngaphezu kwezigidi ezingama-60 zeePioneers kwihlabathi liphela
ch1-p2: Inyathelo 2: Bhalisa nge-Facebook okanye Ngefowuni → Faka ikhowudi: CHIGALEX1 → Fumana umvuzo we-1 Pi
ch1-p3: Ukugrumba Kwemihla Ngemihla: Buya rhoqo kwiiyure ezingama-24 kwaye ucofe iqhosha lombane ukuze uqhubeke nokugrumba.
ch1-list2:
• Ungasebenzisi igama lobuxoki - kufuneka lihambelane ne-ID ye-KYC
  • Ungenzi ii-akhawunti ezininzi - umntu omnye i-akhawunti enye
  • Setha i-alamu yokugrumba rhoqo kwiiyure ezingama-24 ukugcina izinga
  • Joyina isangqa sokhuseleko emva kweentsuku ezi-3 nabantu abathembekileyo aba-5
ch1-list:
• Yenza isipaji se-Pi ngokukhuselekileyo
  • Gqibezela i-2FA
  • Gqibezela i-KYC
  • Lungiselela ukufuduka kwe-Mainnet
security-msg: ⚠️ Ukhuseleko lwesipaji: Ungaze wabelane ngamagama akho angama-24 e-passphrase! Iqela le-Pi Core SOZE likubuze!
ch2-p1: Isipaji sakho se-Pi yibhanki yakho kwi-Pi Ecosystem. Ibambe iingqekembe zakho ze-Pi ngokukhuselekileyo kwi-blockchain.
ch2-p2: Indlela yokudala: Vula i-Pi Browser → Wallet → Dala i-Wallet → KOPIYA amagama akho angama-24 → Gcina ngaphandle kweintanethi kwiindawo ezi-2 ezikhuselekileyo.
ch2-p3: Ukufumana i-Pi: Yabelana ngedilesi yakho kawonke-wonke (eqala ngo-G...). Ukuthumela i-Pi: Ncamathela idilesi yomamkeli, faka isixa, qinisekisa.
ch2-list:
• Bhala i-passphrase ephepheni, hayi umfanekiso wekhusi
  • Gcina kwiindawo ezi-2 ezikhuselekileyo ezahlukeneyo (hayi ifowuni kuphela)
  • Vavanya nge-1 Pi ngaphambi kokuthumela isixa esikhulu
  • Jonga oonobumba abane bokuqala nabane bokugqibela bedilesi rhoqo
ch2a-p1: Okubonakalayo: Qala ngesixa esincinci sovavanyo (1 Pi). Qinisekisa ukuba oonobumba abane bokuqala nabane bokugqibela bedilesi bayahambelana. Ungaze uncamathele i-passphrase yakho kuyo nayiphi na iwebhusayithi!
ch2a-p2: Umyoliso Ophilayo: Kolu qeqesho, siza kwenza idemo ephilayo yokuthumela i-1 Pi komnye uvulindlela ukwakha ukuzithemba. Khumbula: Uthengiselwano lweBlockchain alunakuguqulwa!
ch3-p1: I-Pi Browser ifana ne-Google Play Store ye-Pi. Ii-DApps zizicelo ezisasaziweyo zokusetyenziswa kokwenyani — ukuthenga, imfundo, imidlalo, iinkonzo zonke zisebenzisa i-Pi.
ch3-list:
• I-Pi Chain Mall (PCM) - Indawo yokuthenga enkulu ye-Pi
  • I-WorkforcePool - Imisebenzi YeePioneers
  • I-CareForPi - Inkxaso yezempilo
  • I-Chigalex1 Hub - Imfundo (Le App)
  • kunye nokusetyenziswa okungama-100+ okungakumbi
ch4-p1: Fumana amashishini amkela i-Pi kwihlabathi jikelele kwi-mapofpi.com. Bhalisa ishishini lakho kwaye uqale ukwamkela i-Pi ngeempahla neenkonzo.
ch4-p2: Indlela Yokubhalisa Ishishini Lakho: Yiya ku-mapofpi.com → Qhagamshela ne-Pi Wallet → Yongeza Ishishini → Yongeza iifoto, indawo, iimveliso → Abathengi bazakufumana! Le yindlela iAfrika eya kukhokelela ekwamkelweni kwe-Pi.
ch5-p1: Ixabiso LeMvumelwano Yehlabathi (GCV) likhuthaza ukusetyenziswa kokwenyani. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Eli xabiso lakhiwa ngamavulandlela asebenzisa i-Pi kurhwebo lokwenyani.
ch5-p2: Intsingiselo ye-GCV: I-GCV ayiloxabiso lotshintshiselwano. Yintshukumo yokukhusela ixabiso le-Pi ngokusebenzisa i-Pi kwimvumelwano ephezulu kwi-barter yethu. Xa sisebenzisa i-Pi kwiimpahla zokwenyani kwi-GCV, sakha imfuno kunye nokusetyenziswa. Oku kuxhobisa uqoqosho lwe-Afrika.
ch6-p1: Funda incwadi ka-Doris Yin yokudala ukusetyenziswa kunye nokukhula kwe-ecosystem. Phanda, funda, kwaye ufundise abanye — yindlela esixhobisa ngayo iAfrika.
ch6-p2: Indima Yakho NjengePhayona yaseAfrika: Funda → Ziqhelise → Fundisa abantu aba-2 → Aba ba-2 bafundise abanye aba-2. Le yindlela sifikelela ngayo kwi-1 Million yamaAfrika afundileyo! Khuphela i-Whitepaper, funda, kwaye wabelane ngolwazi mihla le.
final-msg: I-Afrika inethuba lokuba yenye yezona ndawo zinamandla ekusetyenzisweni okusebenzayo ngaphakathi kwe-Pi Ecosystem. Sikunye Sakha. Sikunye Sifundisa.
